AI Overview
You can create a 3x3 product campaign grid from a single reference photo using AI image generators (such as Midjourney, Gemini, or ComfyUI workflows) with a structured multi-concept prompt. 
Instagram
·aigorithm.ores
 +2
Step-by-Step AI Campaign Grid Method
Upload and Prompt: Provide your product photo to an AI tool and use a structured multi-concept prompt that defines all nine cells while anchoring the product to the reference image. (You can explore sample commercial layout frameworks like the Product Marketing Grid Campaign Prompt.) 
Instagram
·aigorithm.ores
 +1
Design the 9 Grid Concepts: Map out distinct visual directions for each cell—such as an iconic hero shot, macro texture close-up, dynamic liquid interaction, minimal sculptural arrangement, floating elements, sensory close-up, color-driven scene, symbolic component abstraction, and a surreal fusion scene. 
Instagram
·aigorithm.ores
 +1
Enforce Consistency Rules: Add explicit constraints in your prompt to preserve 100% product accuracy (shape, label, typography, and color) under controlled studio lighting. 
Instagram
·aigorithm.ores
Alternative Splitting Method: If you already have a finished high-resolution layout and want to slice it into individual panels for social media, you can use online grid tools like 9grid or Instagram Grid Maker. 
If you'd like, tell me what kind of product you are working with (e.g., skincare, electronics, apparel), and I can tailor the exact prompt and style parameters for your brand.
